pairs.target: huò chéng bānzǒu liǎngtiān hòu , tǎ wéi xiān qù jiàn nài lěi , bǎ xīn dìzhǐ jiāogěi tā , cái gǎnwǎng bàngwǎn de liànxí .
pairs.english: Two days after Huo Cheng moved, Tavi first went to see Nerai and gave her the new address, only then hurrying to the evening practice.
pairs.hanzi: 霍成搬走两天后，塔维先去见奈蕾，把新地址交给她，才赶往傍晚的练习。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn bǎ yuànlǐ de shā sǎopíng , zài liǎngtiáo báixiàn zhījiān fàng le yìzhī ǎi mùdèng , dèng shàng gēzhe zuórì liànggān de hùjù .
pairs.english: Song Yuan swept the courtyard sand level, placed a low wooden stool in the space between two white lines, and on it lay the protective gear dried yesterday.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远把院里的沙扫平，在两条白线之间放了一只矮木凳，凳上搁着昨日晾干的护具。

pairs.target: jīnrì bù ná tiě , tǎ wéi réng yào chuānguò nàduàn zhǎi dì , pèngdào lín kē yāo biān de bù diàn , zài cóng yuán lù tuìchū lái .
pairs.english: Today they would take no iron; Tavi still had to cross that narrow stretch, touch Lin Ke's cloth pad at the waist, then retreat along the same way.
pairs.hanzi: 今日不拿铁，塔维仍要穿过那段窄地，碰到林珂腰边的布垫，再从原路退出来。

pairs.target: tā shǒulǐ de duǎnbàng chán le ruǎnbù , què méiyǒu tì tā bǎ yào zǒu de lù ràngkāi .
pairs.english: The short stick in her hand was wrapped in soft cloth, but she had not cleared for him the path he wanted to take.
pairs.hanzi: 她手里的短棒缠了软布，却没有替他把要走的路让开。

pairs.target: " shàng huí nǐ wǎnghuí kàn , wǒ pèngdào nǐ jiān le . "
pairs.english: “Last time you looked back, I touched your shoulder.”
pairs.hanzi: “上回你往回看，我碰到你肩了。”

pairs.target: tā shuōwán , zìjǐ zài cèzi shàng diǎn le yíxià , xiàng pà tā jīnrì zhǐ jìde qián bànjié .
pairs.english: After speaking, she herself tapped the notebook once, as if afraid that today he remembered only the first half.
pairs.hanzi: 她说完，自己在册子上点了一下，像怕他今日只记得前半截。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō jìde , tā biàn bǎ hù é jìjǐn , ràng tā xiān shuō zhè yìhuí xiǎng shì shénme .
pairs.english: Tavi said he remembered; she then tied her forehead guard tight and let him first say what he wanted to try this time.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说记得，她便把护额系紧，让他先说这一回想试什么。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng dǎngkāi bàngtóu yǐhòu wǎng tā yòubiān zǒu , nàlǐ kàoqiáng , néng shǎo gù yímiàn .
pairs.english: He wanted to deflect the stick's tip and then move to her right, there, close to the wall, he could have less to watch on one side.
pairs.hanzi: 他想挡开棒头以后往她右边走，那里靠墙，能少顾一面。

pairs.target: lín kē wànglewàng qiáng , méi shuō xíngbùxíng , zhǐ wèn sòng yuǎn shìbushì dé zhàozhe ràng .
pairs.english: Lin Ke looked at the wall, did not say whether that would work, and only asked Song Yuan whether she had to yield as planned.
pairs.hanzi: 林珂望了望墙，没说行不行，只问宋远是不是得照着让。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn jiào tā shǒuzhù zìjǐ de bù diàn , búbì tìrén wánchéng dǎsuàn , dàn liǎngbiān réng zhǐ zhǔn zǒu , shuí hǎntíng jiù tíng .
pairs.english: Song Yuan told her to defend her own cloth pad, with no need to carry out someone else's plan; but both sides were still only allowed to walk, and whoever called a stop, they stopped.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远叫她守住自己的布垫，不必替人完成打算，但两边仍只准走，谁喊停就停。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi dīxiàtóu , bǎ qiánrì gāng xué de huójié jiěkāi , chóngxīn jiāng yāo diàn jì hǎo .
pairs.english: Tavi lowered his head, undid the slipknot he had just learned the day before yesterday, and fastened the waist pad again.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维低下头，把前日刚学的活结解开，重新将腰垫系好。

pairs.target: huò chéngjiào de jié zài tā shǒulǐ méi nàme lìluò , lín kē děng dé jiāng duǎnbàng huàn le liǎngcì shǒu .
pairs.english: The knot Huo Cheng taught was not so neat in his hands; while waiting, Lin Ke shifted the short stick between hands twice.
pairs.hanzi: 霍成教的结在他手里没那么利落，林珂等得将短棒换了两次手。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu cuī , děng tā qǐshēn shí quèshuō , bǎng zhèmejiǔ , zài diàoxiàlái kě jiù dé suàn tā yíng .
pairs.english: She did not hurry him, but when he rose she said that after all that time tying it, if it fell off again they really would have to count it as her win.
pairs.hanzi: 她没有催，等他起身时却说，绑这么久，再掉下来可就得算她赢。

pairs.target: tóuyìhuí , tǎ wéi yòng hùjù pèng kāi bàngtóu , yánzhe qiángbiān nuó bù , lín kē què xiān bǎ yòujiǎo shōuhuí le bànbù .
pairs.english: On the first attempt, Tavi knocked the stick's tip aside with his protective gear and edged along the wall, but Lin Ke first drew her right foot back half a step.
pairs.hanzi: 头一回，塔维用护具碰开棒头，沿着墙边挪步，林珂却先把右脚收回了半步。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu jiākuài , duǎnbàng réng héng zài liǎng rén zhījiān , tā yuányǐwéi yǐjīng kòng chūlái de nà yíkuài yòu zhǎi le .
pairs.english: She had not sped up; the short stick still lay across the gap between them, and the space he originally thought was already clear grew narrow again.
pairs.hanzi: 她没有加快，短棒仍横在两人之间，他原以为已经空出来的那一块又窄了。

pairs.target: tā dīng zhe nà kuài dìfāng , xiǎng zàijǐ yíxià , yāo biān hūrán yìqīng , lín kē de bùtóu pèngshàng hùdiàn , yòu lìkè shōuhuí .
pairs.english: He stared at that patch of space, wanting to squeeze in once more; suddenly there was a light touch at his waist: Lin Ke's cloth tip touched the pad, then immediately withdrew.
pairs.hanzi: 他盯着那块地方，想再挤一下，腰边忽然一轻，林珂的布头碰上护垫，又立刻收回。

pairs.target: " tíng . "
pairs.english: “Stop.”

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn shuōhuà shí , tā de hùjù hái dǐng zhe bàng , jiǎo què yǐjīng cǎi dào báixiàn wàimiàn .
pairs.english: When Song Yuan spoke, his protective gear was still pressing against the stick, but his foot had already stepped outside the white line.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远说话时，他的护具还顶着棒，脚却已经踩到白线外面。

pairs.target: lín kē dūnxiàqù zhǐ nàge xiéyìn , wèn tā fāngcái dàodǐ yǒuméiyǒu kànjiàn tā huàn jiǎo .
pairs.english: Lin Ke crouched to point at that footprint and asked him whether he had actually seen her change her footing just now.
pairs.hanzi: 林珂蹲下去指那个鞋印，问他方才到底有没有看见她换脚。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎng shuō kànjiàn le , huàdàozuǐbiān , gǎichéng zhǐ kànjiàn zìjǐ xiǎng qù de dìfāng .
pairs.english: Tavi wanted to say he had seen it; the words reached his lips, and he changed them to having seen only the place he himself wanted to go.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想说看见了，话到嘴边，改成只看见自己想去的地方。

pairs.target: tā yǒudiǎn nǎo , bùquánshì nǎo tā , nàtiáo lù míngmíng zài kāitóu hǎohǎo dì kòng zhe .
pairs.english: He was a little annoyed, not entirely with her; that path had clearly been perfectly open at the start.
pairs.hanzi: 他有点恼，不全是恼她，那条路明明在开头好好地空着。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn méi bǎ tā nuó guò de bànbù mǒdiào , jiào tǎ wéi cóng xiéyìn páng zǒu huíqù , kànkàn qiáng jiūjìng tì shuí shǎo gù le yímiàn .
pairs.english: Song Yuan did not erase the half-step she had taken; he told Tavi to walk back beside the footprint and look at whom the wall had actually spared one side to watch.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远没把她挪过的半步抹掉，叫塔维从鞋印旁走回去，看看墙究竟替谁少顾了一面。

pairs.target: qiáng búràng tǎ wéi wǎng pángbiān zài ràng , lín kē què néng shùnzhe zhǎi dì shǒuzhù tā .
pairs.english: The wall prevented Tavi from yielding farther sideways, while Lin Ke could hold him along the narrow space.
pairs.hanzi: 墙不让塔维往旁边再让，林珂却能顺着窄地守住他。

pairs.target: xiēxī shí tā zhāi le hù é , éjiǎo shī le yípiàn , wèn shìbushì gǎi dào tā jìn , tǎ wéi shǒu .
pairs.english: During the break she took off her forehead guard, her temples wet, and asked whether they should switch to her advancing and Tavi defending.
pairs.hanzi: 歇息时她摘了护额，额角湿了一片，问是不是改到她进，塔维守。

pairs.target: tā diǎntóu , bǎ bù diàn nuó zhèng , què méiyǒu shuō zhè yìhuí yídìng yào pèngdào tā cái suàn .
pairs.english: He nodded, straightened the cloth pad, but did not say this time would only count if he touched her.
pairs.hanzi: 他点头，把布垫挪正，却没有说这一回一定要碰到她才算。

pairs.target: lín kē jìnlái shí yě méi zhào tā xiǎng de zǒu , tā xiān jiāng bàngtóu kàojìn tā de hùjù , yòu chè kāi , děng tā zhuī zhe qù dǎng .
pairs.english: As Lin Ke advanced she did not move as he expected either; she first moved the stick's tip close to his protective gear, then pulled it away, waiting for him to follow and block.
pairs.hanzi: 林珂进来时也没照他想的走，她先将棒头靠近他的护具，又撤开，等他追着去挡。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shǒu tái le yíbàn , jiǎogēn xiān zhuàng dào zìjǐ liúxià de xiéyìn , tā hūrán bùxiǎng bǎ liǎngzhī jiǎo dōu jǐ dào tóngyígè dìfāng .
pairs.english: Tavi's hand was halfway raised when his heel first met the footprint he himself had left; suddenly he did not want to crowd both feet into the same spot.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维手抬了一半，脚跟先撞到自己留下的鞋印，他忽然不想把两只脚都挤到同一个地方。

pairs.target: tā wǎnghòu ràng , lín kē zài jìn , tā yòu ràng , dào dìèrtiáo xiàn qián biàn hǎn le tíng .
pairs.english: He yielded backward; Lin Ke advanced again, he yielded once more, and just before the second line he called a stop.
pairs.hanzi: 他往后让，林珂再进，他又让，到第二条线前便喊了停。

pairs.target: tā de bùtóu méi pèngdào tā , tā yě méi pèngdào tā , liǎng rén zhōngjiān liú zhe yì jié shuí dōu bù mǎnyì de kòngdì .
pairs.english: Her cloth tip did not touch him, nor did he touch her; between them remained a stretch of empty ground that satisfied neither.
pairs.hanzi: 她的布头没碰到他，他也没碰到她，两人中间留着一截谁都不满意的空地。

pairs.target: lín kē shuō zhèyàng xiàqù , zìjǐ néng bǎ tā sòngdào yuàn ménkǒu , tǎ wéi shuō kěxī jīnrì zhǐ sǎo dào zhèlǐ .
pairs.english: Lin Ke said that at this rate she could escort him to the courtyard gate; Tavi said unfortunately they had only swept this far today.
pairs.hanzi: 林珂说这样下去，自己能把他送到院门口，塔维说可惜今日只扫到这里。

pairs.target: tā zhōngyú xiào le yíxià , bǎ bàng jiá dào yèxià , jiào tā bié chèn zìjǐ xiào yòu wǎngqián pèng .
pairs.english: She finally laughed once, tucked the stick under her arm, and told him not to take advantage of her laughter to reach forward again.
pairs.hanzi: 她终于笑了一下，把棒夹到腋下，叫他别趁自己笑又往前碰。

pairs.target: tā xiào wán yòu kàn le kàn dìèrtiáo xiàn , shuō zhēn yào shǒu huòchē , zìjǐ bùnéng gēnzhe tuì zhème yuǎn , chē búhuì tì tā wǎnghòuzǒu .
pairs.english: After laughing she looked again at the second line, saying that if she really had to guard a freight wagon she could not retreat this far along with him; the wagon would not move backward for her.
pairs.hanzi: 她笑完又看了看第二条线，说真要守货车，自己不能跟着退这么远，车不会替她往后走。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi běn xiǎng shuō bú tuì jiù áidǎ , wàngjiàn tā jiāng bù diàn nuó dào shēn qián , yòu bǎ huà yàn huíqù .
pairs.english: Tavi had meant to say that without retreating she would get hit, but seeing her shift the cloth pad to her front he swallowed the words again.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维本想说不退就挨打，望见她将布垫挪到身前，又把话咽回去。

pairs.target: tājiā de rén zhǐ kěn ràng tā yèlǐ tídēng , tā yào xué de bìng búshì bǎ dēng rēngxià , zìjǐ xiān pǎo .
pairs.english: Her family would only let her carry a lamp at night; what she wanted to learn was not to throw down the lamp and run away first herself.
pairs.hanzi: 她家的人只肯让她夜里提灯，她要学的并不是把灯扔下，自己先跑。

pairs.target: tā wèn xiàhuí shìbushì yào bǎ dèngzi dāng chē , tā shuō xiān bié , tā hái méi nòng míngbái gāngcái wèishénme yì zhuī tā jiù líkāi qiáng le .
pairs.english: He asked whether next time they should use the stool as a wagon; she said not yet, since she still had not worked out why just now she had left the wall as soon as she pursued him.
pairs.hanzi: 他问下回是不是要把凳子当车，她说先别，她还没弄明白刚才为什么一追他就离开墙了。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn ràng tāmen gè xiě yìháng , tǎ wéi xiān jì yòucè méi zǒu chéng , yòu tiān tuì dào le nǎlǐ , méi jiāng méi ái shàng xiěchéng yíng .
pairs.english: Song Yuan had them each write one line; Tavi first recorded that the right side had not worked, then added where he had retreated to, not writing a win for not getting hit.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远让他们各写一行，塔维先记右侧没走成，又添退到了哪里，没将没挨上写成赢。

pairs.target: lín kē xiě dé bǐ tā kuài , wèn xiàhuí néng bunéng huàn tā xiān shuō yào shǒu nǎbiān , tā bùxiǎng měi huí dōu děng biérén lái shì .
pairs.english: Lin Ke wrote faster than him and asked whether next time it could be her turn to say first which side she would defend; she did not want to wait for someone else to try every time.
pairs.hanzi: 林珂写得比他快，问下回能不能换她先说要守哪边，她不想每回都等别人来试。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn dāying xiān kàn chǎngdì , méi xǔ tā bǎ sùdù tí qǐlái , biàn bǎ hùjù shōuhuí mùdèng .
pairs.english: Song Yuan agreed to look at the space first, did not allow her to increase the speed, then returned the protective gear to the wooden stool.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远答应先看场地，没许她把速度提起来，便把护具收回木凳。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi qù jiě yāo diàn , nàge jié zhèhuí yì lā jiù kāi , tā zhèng xiǎng jiào lín kē kàn , tā yǐjīng bào zhe zìjǐ de cèzi wǎng shuǐcáo qù le .
pairs.english: Tavi went to undo his waist pad; this time that knot opened with one pull, and he was just about to call Lin Ke to look when she was already heading to the water trough holding her own notebook.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维去解腰垫，那个结这回一拉就开，他正想叫林珂看，她已经抱着自己的册子往水槽去了。

pairs.target: tā zhǐhǎo bǎ shéng tóu zuàn zài shǒulǐ , zhuīshàngqù wèn tā gāngcái nà bànbù , néng bunéng zài mànmàn zǒuyíbiàn .
pairs.english: He could only clasp the end of the cord in his hand and catch up to ask her whether she could slowly repeat that half-step from just now once more.
pairs.hanzi: 他只好把绳头攥在手里，追上去问她刚才那半步，能不能再慢慢走一遍。
